title: Fast semantic regression pack
description: The versioned fast pack: one quick executable slice of every Q0/Q1 catalog rule for local change and PR feedback, plus the historical defects and the suites it never replaces. The loader that judges it is tools/regressionpack.

schema.description: The only pack version the loader understands.

generator.description: The tool that owns the shape of this document.

scope.description: Where the fast pack runs: local change and PR, never nightly or release.

budget_seconds.description: The measured wall-clock budget of one fast-pack run.

does_not_replace.description: The suites the fast pack never replaces: nightly and release at minimum.

full_suite.description: The complete-suite targets that own certification.
